blocks.text: Buying a Home in Majuba Hill, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Majuba Hill

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Majuba Hill Road, Wilson Road, Wiltshire Street, and Highway 1 Exit 104 (No. 3 Road) and Exit 109 (Yale Road West). Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Majuba Hill will find rural hillside acreages (typically 2 to 10+ acres), custom view houses, hobby farms, and private wooded estates overlooking Sumas Prairie and the North Cascade mountains. blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Majuba Hill

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Majuba Hill are served by Yarrow Community School (K–5 at 4595 Wilson Road), Greendale Elementary, Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Majuba Heritage Park (4132 Wilson Road) and nearby Yarrow Pioneer Park, Yarrow Library, and Vedder River trails at the base of the hill. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by nearby BC Transit Route 55 in Yarrow and direct commuter access to Abbotsford and Chilliwack via Highway 1 Exit 104 and Exit 109.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Majuba Hill

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Majuba Hill are regulated by City of Chilliwack Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland slope stability, erosion control, and wildfire hazard requirements), private drilled well and septic servicing rules, and ALR boundary policies. Before removing subjects on a property in Majuba Hill, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Majuba Hill?

Key road corridors serving Majuba Hill include Majuba Hill Road, Wilson Road, Wiltshire Street, and Highway 1 Exit 104 (No. 3 Road) and Exit 109 (Yale Road West). Public transit connections include nearby BC Transit Route 55 in Yarrow and direct commuter access to Abbotsford and Chilliwack via Highway 1 Exit 104 and Exit 109.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Majuba Hill?

Properties in Majuba Hill are governed by City of Chilliwack Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland slope stability, erosion control, and wildfire hazard requirements), private drilled well and septic servicing rules, and ALR boundary policies. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Majuba Hill freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Majuba Hill are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land.
